## Carousel.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `index` :: The index of the first visible slide.
- `onIndexChange` :: Called when the current slide changes.
- `loop` :: When true, next and previous wrap around the ends.
- `autoplay` :: Auto-advance. Pass `true` for 5s, or an interval in milliseconds. Pauses on hover, focus and reduced motion.
- `perView` :: How many slides are visible at once.
- `gap` :: The gap between slides.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the indicator that slides between the dots.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a dot that is not the current slide.
- `navButtonProps` :: Props passed on to the previous and next arrows — variant, size, icon or anything else `Button` takes. Spread after the carousel's own defaults, so it wins.
- `label` :: Names the carousel for assistive technology.
- `children` :: The slides — `CarouselSlide`s laid out in one horizontal track.

## CarouselSlide.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `label` :: An accessible name for this slide, announced with its position.
- `children` :: The slide content.

## carousel.svelte.ts

### `interface SlideMeta`

A registered slide.

### `interface CarouselContext`

Shared state between Carousel and CarouselSlide.

- `uid` :: The carousel's unique id prefix.
- `register` :: Register a slide element; returns an unregister function.
- `index` :: The current slide index.
- `total` :: How many slides are registered.
- `position` :: The 0-based position of a slide node, or -1 if it has not registered yet.
